title: Nonprofit Spotlight: Oak Cottage for Women
summary: The CoreCivic Foundation is proud to support Oak Cottage for Women, a nonprofit organization that helps justice-involved women on their journey to successful reentry.
body_markdown:
The CoreCivic Foundation is honored to partner with nonprofit organizations that support justice-involved individuals, victims of crime and abuse and at-risk youth.


One of our newest partners is **Oak Cottage for Women** , located in Franklin, Tennessee. The Oak Cottage for Women exists to provide a safe residential home to formerly incarcerated women as a bridge to re-entering society as a productive citizen. This group seeks to create a balanced spiritual, physical and vocational foundation for daily living through Christ-centered, compassionate care.
